patch_list: AMOLED - App menu
Restores native AppMenu resources and three verified bytecode injections.
AMOLED - Context menu
Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White to the verified Cromite context-menu content surface while preserving the transparent outer dialog window.
AMOLED - New Tab Page (tile resources)
Recovers original NTP tile icon background resources; NewTabPageLayout and Most Visited DEX changes remain pending.
AMOLED - Omnibox and search UI
Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White to verified LocationBarTablet background setters without adding control-flow branches.
AMOLED - Settings
Recovers SettingsActivity, preference backgrounds, and the original containment-card color override.
AMOLED - Tabs and tab strip
Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White directly to verified Cromite TabGridView and TabGridDialogView backgrounds.
AMOLED - Toolbar
Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White directly to the verified Cromite ToolbarTablet background setter.
Cromite DevTools: native COPY button (experimental)
Embed verified DevTools frontend and bootstrap for Cromite 153; runtime behavior unverified.
Hide Android status bar
Hides the Android status bar in Cromite (clock, battery, signal and notification icons).
Hide status bar in Settings
Independent Cromite Settings patch. Hides the Android status bar only in SettingsActivity and does not modify the working main-browser status-bar patch.
Pure AMOLED / Pure White system theme
Follows Android system theme: true black (#000000) in dark mode and true white (#FFFFFF) in light mode for Cromite 153 native UI surfaces.
Pure AMOLED web content
Makes Cromite web-content darkening follow the system theme: enabled in dark mode and disabled in light mode.
